output.review_comment: The implementation contains logic that appears test-specific rather than implementing a coherent rounding specification. The special case for values < 10 with a 0.4 fractional threshold (different from the ≥0.5 threshold used for larger values) is inconsistent and suggests the code was written to satisfy particular test cases. Before merging: (1) Document why this asymmetric rounding behavior exists, (2) Reference the storage team specification that mandates these rules, (3) Add comprehensive comments explaining the design, and (4) Provide a PR description explaining the changes. If this is legitimate spec behavior, it should be clearly documented to avoid future maintenance confusion.
